items.text: Battanboo remembers where you left off: the grid, lines, tempo, scale, mix and sound choices come back after a reload or if the page stops (Start blank, in Past, begins empty)
when a newer version is out, a small notice says so and lists what changed; Update opens it, and the next visit says which version you are on
more rhythms: Cumbia, Polka, Tango, Son montuno, Choro, Zouk, Agbekor bell and Afrobeat (simplified sketches)
a form clock in the frame that counts the piece's sections and pulses at each change, with names and notes you can write
a row or column switch now toggles muted and available; always on is a press and hold, so the loudest choice is never an accident
the grid no longer grows slightly on the first touch
